## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Aug 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Colton Capps_, Jul 15, 2026, 1/5: "Any app that limits functionality behind a paywall for basic features gets a 1 star from me. If you just offered bonus features or more benefits, I wouldn’t be upset, but you limit people on the amount of tasks they can create, lists they can make, countdowns they can have, and habits they can track. After a short amount of time using this app, it becomes unusable without forking over money every month. I can’t even check off my repeating tasks now that I have “reached my limit.” Quit being so greedy."
            2. _rudie.cant.fail_, Aug 24, 2026, 4/5: "Great app with a lot of good free features but a lot of things are behind a paywall"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 17, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Albro17_, Aug 17, 2026, 5/5: "Incredibly helpful in the ongoing battle against procrastination. I use it every day to keep track of my working hours, and bring order to the chaos that is being self-employed. The app's interface is refreshingly clean, there's a myriad of useful features and no annoying ads anywhere (I'm using the free version). One of those rare examples where the developers seem to have prioritised functionality over monetisation. Wouldn't wanna spend a day without it."
